title: _fit.json - fit against the CALIBRATION targets only
description: Written by src/calibrate/fit.py. Structurally cannot contain a holdout value: load_targets() filters split == 'calibration' at read time and raises if anything else survives. EVERY FIT STATISTIC NAMES THE TARGET IDS IT WAS COMPUTED OVER - a statistic that does not name its targets is not reportable, because 'fits 67 targets' is a much stronger claim than this data supports (DECISIONS.md 12.1).

run.description: Run directory name; the run identity.

fraction.description: Sample fraction. Every extensive quantity below is scaled by it.

calibration_targets_available.description: Rows with split == 'calibration'. The holdout is never read.

unscorable.description: Every target that could not be scored, WITH A REASON. Reported as loudly as what could be scored. scored + len(unscorable) must equal calibration_targets_available, and fit.py exits if it does not - an earlier cut scored 35 and explained 16 of 67, leaving 16 neither scored nor explained.

occupancy_constraint.description: Modelled ride:car ratio against the observed passenger:driver ratio. This is a CONSTRAINT being checked, not a target being fitted (DECISIONS.md 8.5, 9.8).

targets.description: The target ids this statistic was computed over. Required.
